name: EuroSports Global Limited
summary: Headquartered in Singapore and established in 1998, EuroSports Global Limited functions as an investment holding company primarily engaged in the distribution and retail of automobiles. Its operations span Singapore, wider Southeast Asia, and international territories, structured across its Automobiles Distribution, Sustainable Mobility, and Other segments. The company specializes in selling both brand-new luxury vehicles and pre-owned cars. Beyond sales, it offers comprehensive after-sales support, encompassing maintenance, cleaning, repair, breakdown assistance, and the supply of automotive parts and accessories. In the realm of sustainable mobility, EuroSports Global actively researches, develops, wholesales, and retails electric motorcycles and their components, while also distributing other two-wheeled vehicles like scooters and motorcycles, and providing electric mobility and energy solutions. Additionally, its activities include the trade and distribution of watches and the provision of various management services, all primarily serving high-net-worth individuals.
